name: check_data_freshness
description: 檢查所有數據檔案的更新時間

creation_path.why: 數據不新鮮 = 整個系統在用過時資訊做決策
creation_path.flow_awareness: A 輸出 live_data → B/C 讀取 → D/E 輸出 leaderboard → F 讀取

steps.description: 檢查 trade_logs 最新交易時間
steps.command: find {ARENA_ROOT}/arena_control/trade_logs -name '*.json' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -5 | while read ts path; do date -d @$ts '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M' | tr -d '\n'; echo " $path"; done || echo 'no trade logs'
